caption:
BestMediaInfo publishes a Talent Tracker every week. Leadership changes across media, marketing and corporate India, listed by name and title. A new edition landed two days ago. There will be another one next week, and the week after that.

Read a few editions and the pattern becomes hard to miss. Many of the people named are not out-delivering you. Their numbers are not better. Their hours are not longer.

What separated them happened in rooms, not spreadsheets. How they held the floor when challenged. What they did in the three seconds before answering. Whether the senior-most person in the room turned toward them when the topic changed.

Output gets you considered. Command decides. In 35 years of military service, Colonel Suhag watched competent officers stall because they had never been taught to occupy a room.

Bearing. Tone. Calculated silence. These are trainable. Start treating them that way.

topic.title: Weekly India Inc leadership churn as renewable format
topic.angle: The audience watches these appointment announcements knowing the person named is often no more capable than they are — proof that promotion runs on something other than output.
topic.why_now: BestMediaInfo's Talent Tracker published a new edition two days ago and regenerates weekly by design, so it fuels this fortnight and the next.

rationale: A stark text-only visual matches the caption's blunt argument and keeps focus on the single line that reframes why the overlooked stay overlooked.
